_doc: Period manuals fetched for the OA11 evidence pass (basis of plausible-procedural scenes; never evidence for a unit on a day). archive.org only, 1 request per second, no login. Text under tmp/life/lib/ (untracked); rebuild with tools/bt/life/acquire_texts.py.

items.title: Hard Tack And Coffee
items.creator: John D. Billings
items.purpose: a veteran's general account of rations, cooking, camp and picket life: general practice only, never specific to a unit or day

items.title: Camp and outpost duty for infantry : with standing orders, extracts from the revised regulations for the army, rules for health, maxims for soldiers, and duties of officers
items.creator: Butterfield, Daniel, 1831-1901
items.purpose: camp routine, pickets, outposts, cooking and meals in the field; written by the Army of the Potomac chief of staff of July 1863

items.title: Manual for engineer troops ..
items.creator: Duane, James Chatham, 1824-1897
items.purpose: pontoon and trestle bridges, roads, tools of engineer troops, working parties

items.title: A treatise on field fortification, containing instructions on the methods of laying out, constructing, defending, and attacking intrenchments; with the general outlines also of the arrangement, the attack and defence of permanent fortifications
items.creator: Mahan, D. H. (Dennis Hart), 1802-1871
items.purpose: profiles, tools, labour per work and the order of building of breastworks, epaulements, gun pits, abatis, rifle pits

items.title: Regulations for the army of the Confederate States, 1863. Revised and enlarged with a new and copious index
creator: Confederate States of America. War Dept
